docs.title: Starflake ontology
docs.text:
Domain ontology for Starflake, an open-world 3D space explorer.

A pilot flies a ship through a galaxy of star systems, shoots raiders and asteroids, scoops up the fuel they leave, and jumps to a neighbouring system once the tank holds enough fuel.

The ontology describes the universe only, in words one of its inhabitants would use. How the game is played, hosted and tuned is specified in the design repository.

The schema has two layers:

  • Content (Galaxy): what exists, such as ship classes, weapons, raider and asteroid types, and the star systems.
  • State (GalaxyState): what is where at one moment, which references content by identifier.

Units: distances in metres, time in seconds, angles in radians.

URI: https://w3id.org/M4jor-Tom/starflake-ontology

Name: starflake-ontology

docs.title: starflake-ontology
docs.text:
Domain ontology for Starflake, an open-world 3D space explorer.

A pilot flies a ship through a galaxy of star systems, shoots raiders and asteroids, scoops up the fuel they leave, and jumps to a neighbouring system once the tank holds enough fuel.

The ontology describes the universe only, in words one of its inhabitants would use. How the game is played, hosted and tuned is specified in the design repository.

The schema has two layers:

  • Content (Galaxy): what exists, such as ship classes, weapons, raider and asteroid types, and the star systems.
  • State (GalaxyState): what is where at one moment, which references content by identifier.

Units: distances in metres, time in seconds, angles in radians.

URI: https://w3id.org/M4jor-Tom/starflake-ontology
